comparison.objective: Extract a robot-assembly spacer using a pusher.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a pusher with an assembly component and apply controlled force to drive the spacer out.
comparison.success_condition: Spacer extraction must satisfy detailed contact checks; the body gives no numeric extraction or damage thresholds.
comparison.reason: This is the closest tool-assisted neighbor, but its central outcome is pushing an intact spacer out. The candidate instead fractures four sacrificial tangs at notches, retains every coil, and collects every fragment.
